title: Senior BI Developer @ ING Hubs Romania
full_description:
Discover ING Hubs Romania
ING Hubs Romania offers 130 services in software development, data management, non-financial risk & compliance, audit, and retail operations to 24 ING units worldwide, with the help ofover 2000 high-performing engineers, risk, and operations professionals.
We started out in 2015 as ING’s software development hub, then steadily expanded our range to include more services and competencies. Now we provide borderless services with bank-wide capabilities andoperate from two locations: Bucharest and Cluj-Napoca.
Our tech capabilities remain the core of our business, with more than 1800 colleagues active in Data and Analytics Tech, Tech Foundation and Channels,Retail Core Banking and Architecture, andGlobal Products and Technology Services.
We enjoy a flexible way of working and a highly collaborative environment, where fair and constructive feedback is encouraged.
For us, impact isn't a perk. It's the driver of our work. We are guided and rewarded by a shared desire to make the world a better place, one innovative solution at a time. Our colleagues make it their job to do impactful things and they love doing it in good company. Do you?
The Business Intelligence team is responsible for data ingestion, data modelling, creating and maintaining various reports across different product lines like lending, transaction services or financial markets both for regulatory and non-regulatory purposes.
Even if you’ll start your day from the comfort of your home or drink your morning coffee in our office’s garden, your day will be quite similar when comes to tasks. Here are your daily responsibilities:
Help our business teams to get more insights from data. How?collaborate with our colleagues from Data Lake who are sending us the data from the applicationsdo your thing and ingest that data with SSISmodel it and prepare it for reporting with SSASsmartly present it in Power BI or SSRS reports

do your thing and ingest that data with SSIS
model it and prepare it for reporting with SSAS
smartly present it in Power BI or SSRS reports
Maintain the existing setup created by your illustrious predecessors:implement optimization mechanismspropose new ways in which data can be presentedhelp with migrations to newer software versions
implement optimization mechanisms
propose new ways in which data can be presented
help with migrations to newer software versions
All the above should be done using Visual Studio & Azure DevOps
Let’s not forget about risk. Ensure that the data is properly used by enforcing risk rules that keep us safe.
What you’ll bring to the team
Experience:more than 10 years
Good knowledge ofMicrosoft SQL Server 2019 or higher,SSIS and SSAS
OLAP Modelling exposure
Experience withdata warehouse, data modelling and reports
Experience in reports presentation usingPower BI or SSRS
Experience in dealing with large quantities of data (and performance tuning)
Experience with pair programming and automated release management
Ability to translate business requirements
Passionate about data insights
Experience with Azure DevOpsis considered a plus
Tech stack/ knowledge:
Mandatory:SQL Server 2019 or higher, SSIS 2019 or higher, SSAS 2019 or higher, SSRS 2019, Power BI
Nice to have:Cloud knowledge
Foreign languages:English (advanced)
Education: nice to have bachelor’s degree (or higher) in an IT related field
